TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Code that indicates the type of transaction being undertaken in accordance with ISO 8583, Transaction Type.

TransactionSubType.name: Transaction Sub Type
TransactionSubType.definition: Further breakdown of the transaction type being performed.

TransactionAttribute.name: Transaction Attribute
TransactionAttribute.definition: Attribute of the transaction. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

Cancellation.name: Cancellation
Cancellation.definition: Indicates the previous message is cancelled.

Collection.name: Collection
Collection.definition: Indicates the finanical message is the collection only, no clearing and settlement required.

SubsequentTransactionType.name: Subsequent Transaction Type
SubsequentTransactionType.definition: Indicates the type of transaction that will follow an approved InquiryVerificationResponse or AuthorizationResponse.

MessageReason.name: Message Reason
MessageReason.definition: Reason or purpose to send the message.

AlternateMessageReason.name: Alternate Message Reason
AlternateMessageReason.definition: Supports message reason codes that are not defined in external code list.

PreAuthorisationTimeLimit.name: Pre Authorisation Time Limit
PreAuthorisationTimeLimit.definition: Contains the period (expressed in minutes) within which a merchant is expected to complete the transaction.

TransactionDescription.name: Transaction Description
TransactionDescription.definition: Transaction data related to programmes and services, content and format based on bilateral agreements.

RoutingTableIdentification.name: Routing Table Identification
RoutingTableIdentification.definition: Indicate which routing table acquirer used to determine the network/program Id.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.

LocalData.name: Local Data
LocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of data in the current component.
